operations.title: Entry 1217 — The Physical Five-Site Marked Arrangement Is Linear on a Multi-Kummer Cover
operations.summary: On the physical three-coordinate Gram base, adjoining the five labelled edge energies gives det(H)y_i^2=F_i. The generic cover has degree 32 and deck group C2^5. All 26 source facets across 180 OFPT terms remain linear in (X_i,y_i); after forgetting y_i they appear algebraic. Branch support is only det(H)=0 and the five edge-soft divisors F_i=0.

operations.title: Benincasa derives the physical five-site marked multi-Kummer cover
operations.body: Entry 1217 pulls the frozen 26-facet/180-term arrangement onto the physical d=3 base. Adjoining five labelled edge sheets det(H)y_i^2=F_i produces a generic degree-32 C2^5 Kummer cover. Every q_A, q_G, and q_{G\e} remains linear in (X_i,y_i). Apparent nonlinear walls arise only after forgetting the coefficient sheets. Branch support is exactly det(H)=0 plus the five labelled edge-soft divisors. Next is the C2^5 character audit of Entry 1203's rank-240 occurrence kernel and its Rees/Koszul attachment.
